fullDescription: A sophisticated minimalist AI Agent interface featuring a dark mode aesthetic with high-contrast monochrome tones. Built with General Sans and Inter typography, the design emphasizes clarity and negative space. Suitable for advanced developer tools, AI chat interfaces, SaaS dashboards, and technical platforms. The layout utilizes a clean vertical flow with bento-style list items, a bottom-anchored input bar, and a distinct lack of containment for agent responses to ensure natural text flow. Key features include glass-like borders, subtle hover transitions, and a refined color palette of #0A0A0A, #111, and #E8E8E8.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, dark-themed AI chat interface that prioritizes text readability and minimal UI friction. It features a high-contrast monochromatic color scheme, subtle border-based containers for user input, and an open, borderless layout for AI-generated content to create an integrated document-like experience.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-fidelity dark mode UI. Background: #0A0A0A. Primary Text: #E8E8E8 (Inter or General Sans). Secondary Text: #999 or #666. Typography: Body text at 15px with 1.6 leading; Subheadings at 12px, 0.2em letter-spacing, uppercase, font-weight 600. Borders: 1px solid #222 or #333. Corner Radius: 16px (2xl) for cards and inputs. Buttons: Primary action buttons should use #E8E8E8 background with #0A0A0A text. Transitions: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Icons: Use Lucide-style thin-stroke icons in #888 or #E8E8E8.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Fixed top header with 56px height (pt-14, pb-4). Includes a 40x40px circular back button (#222 hover) on the left and a 32x32px gradient-fill user avatar (from #333 to #555) on the right. Bottom border: 1px solid #222.

### Recent Conversations List
A vertical stack of conversation cards. Each card: 16px padding, 16px border-radius, background #0A0A0A, border 1px solid #222. Title: 14px Medium weight. Preview text: 13px, #999, single line clamp. Active/Highlighted card uses background #111. Hover effect: border changes to #444.

### Active Chat Feed
A scrollable area with 32px vertical gaps between message blocks. User messages: Right-aligned, max-width 85%, background #222, border 1px solid #333, text 14px, rounded-2xl with bottom-right corner squared (rounded-tr-none). AI messages: Left-aligned, no background, no border, no padding. Includes an 8x8px square bot icon in #111 container. AI content flows as standard typography with 16px paragraph spacing and 8px list item spacing.

### Thought Process / Steps
Before the AI text response, include a list of 'agent steps' in #888 text color, 13px size, JetBrains Mono font. Each step should appear on a new line to simulate real-time processing logs.

### Input Footer
Fixed bottom bar with 34px bottom padding. Centered input container with 1px border #222, background #111, 16px border-radius. Input text: 14px, #E8E8E8. Right-aligned action button: 40x40px, rounded-xl, background #E8E8E8, text #0A0A0A, containing a horizontal send icon.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Borderless AI Response — A clean text block for AI output that avoids the 'chat bubble' look.
Display AI response as raw text within the flex container. Text color: #E8E8E8. Font size: 15px. Line height: 1.6. Use a 20px bottom margin for paragraphs. Bold text within responses should use #FFFFFF and 600 weight. Use standard disc bullets for lists with a 20px left indentation.

### Bento Conversation Card — Minimalist list item for recent history.
A container with background #111, border #222, 16px padding, and 16px radius. Includes a 14px title and a 13px #999 description. On hover, the border transitions to #444 with a cubic-bezier ease.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Tech-Noir' minimalism. It uses a base background of #0A0A0A, paired with structural borders in #222 and #333. Typography pairs the sleek 'General Sans' for headers/body with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical tasks and 'Inter' for UI labels. The color palette is strictly monochromatic: #0A0A0A (background), #111 (secondary surfaces), #222 (borders), #E8E8E8 (primary text/accents). Animations are smooth, utilizing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for all hover and state transitions.
